reports.title: Illumina Reports Financial Results for Third Quarter of Fiscal Year 2026

guidance.heading: Fiscal year 2026 guidance
section: For fiscal year 2026 and excluding tariff refunds, Illumina now expects:
•Total revenue of $4.64-$4.66 billion versus prior guidance of $4.60-$4.64 billion.
•Organic revenue growth greater than 4% and ROW organic revenue growth greater than 5%, both unchanged versus prior guidance.
•Non-GAAP operating margin of 23.6% versus prior guidance of 23.4%-23.6%.
•Non-GAAP diluted EPS of $5.40-$5.45 versus prior guidance of $5.30-$5.40.
